_comment: The replicated population the `replication` frame-capture scenario photographs (issue #325, epic #4). Committed rather than generated so the frames stay comparable across runs and across commits — the same property the fixed VANTAGES exist to protect. Shape and units are the wire's own (client/scripts/wire_codec.gd): positions and radii are integer MILLIMETRES, Y is up, and `observer` is the id this table replicates FOR and therefore may never appear in `entities`. The capture applies this as a base snapshot to the store the shipped ZoneConnection holds, so ReplicaStore.apply and ReplicaView.sync are the real ones; only the socket is absent. Heights sit the capsules on the Reach's ground at these coordinates — the capture raycasts and FAILS if a marker floats, so moving an entity horizontally means re-measuring its y.
